image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a chiton (polyplacophore) clinging to a rocky surface. The organism displays its characteristic eight overlapping dorsal calcareous plates embedded in a hairy, spiny girdle. The texture is rough and armored, with earthy tones of grey, brown, and beige.
